title: Global Strategic Account Executive
description:
Nova oportunidade para Global Strategic Account Executive em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Global Strategic Account Executive  A Blip é uma das líderes globais em Conversational AI, ajudando marcas a transformar a forma como se conectam com seus consumidores em escala. Por meio da nossa plataforma de IA generativa e orquestração conversacional, empresas em mais de 60 países aceleram crescimento, reduzem custos operacionais e constroem jornadas de relacionamento mais eficientes, humanas e escaláveis.  Com atuação global e clientes como Nestlé, Stellantis, América Móvil, Dell, Energisa, Santander e outros líderes de mercado, a Blip está expandindo sua presença internacional e fortalecendo seu time de Strategic Global Accounts.  Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Global Strategic Account Executive com forte visão consultiva, capacidade de influenciar executivos C‑Level e experiência em transformar desafios complexos de negócio em estratégias sustentáveis baseadas em IA, dados e automação. Esta posição será protagonista na expansão global da Blip, liderando o relacionamento com contas estratégicas, identificando oportunidades de crescimento e garantindo captura de valor através de modelos escaláveis de engajamento e adoção do Blip.  Responsabilidades Principais   Atuar como trusted advisor para executivos de grandes clientes globais, liderando agendas de transformação digital, IA e estratégia conversacional.  Construir e executar Account Plans robustos, garantindo expansão, retenção e evolução de portfólio em múltiplas geografias.  Conduzir negociações complexas e multistakeholders (C‑Level, diretores, PMOs, procurement e áreas técnicas).  Ser responsável pelo crescimento do território/designado, garantindo governança, previsibilidade e gestão ativa de KPIs (ARR, DEU, MAU, engajamento, adoção de IA).  Antecipar riscos e oportunidades com visão estratégica e orientada a dados.  Identificar tendências de mercado e comportamentos do consumidor para influenciar estratégias globais.  Conduzir diagnósticos consultivos conectando dores de negócio a capacidades Blip (IA generativa, voice & chatbots, campanhas inteligentes, automações, journeys e analytics).  Traduzir dados e insights em recomendações acionáveis que gerem impacto mensurável.  Apoiar clientes na adoção de modelos escaláveis de conversational commerce, inbound automation, utilities e experiências transacionais de alta conversão.  Construir visão integrada com parceiros estratégicos (Meta/WhatsApp, cloud providers, consultorias, telcos e integradores).  Atuar em forte colaboração com Product, Marketing, Professional Services, Design, Data e Pre‑Sales para entregar soluções arquitetadas ponta a ponta.  Contribuir para melhoria contínua de processos, governança e modelos comerciais.    Requisitos   Experiência comprovada em Strategic Account Management, Consultative Sales, Customer Success Enterprise ou Business Development, preferencialmente em tecnologia, SaaS, telecom, financial services ou setores globais.  Histórico de gestão de relacionamentos executivos, ciclos de negociação complexos e expansão de grandes contas.  Forte capacidade analítica, leitura de KPIs e visão de negócio.  Comunicação excepcional, escrita e verbal, com habilidade de storytelling executivo.  Inglês avançado.  Experiência com planejamento estratégico, gestão de portfólio, business case e modelos comerciais.  Perfil hands‑on com pensamento estratégico e capacidade de operar entre estratégia e execução.  Disponibilidade para trabalhar em formato Híbrido em São Paulo/SP.    Diferenciais   Experiência com plataformas de Conversational AI, Customer Experience, automação, mensageria ou ecossistemas de WhatsApp/Meta.  Vivência em projetos de transformação digital e adoção de IA.  Conhecimento de ferramentas analíticas, Excel avançado e apresentações executivas.  Espanhol avançado. Modelo de Trabalho Flexível: Remoto, híbrido ou presencial, conforme a necessidade da função. Aniversário: Dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário.    Blip Recharge: 5 dias de folga remunerada por ano sem registro de ponto. Convênio SESC: Acesso à cultura, lazer, esportes, hotéis, colônia de férias e mais.    Saúde Física e Emocional   🩺 Plano de Saúde: Cobertura nacional, quarto privativo, com desconto apenas de coparticipação.  🦷 Plano Odontológico: Cobertura nacional, três opções de planos, desconto integral do valor do plano escolhido.  🧠 Conexa Saúde: Plataforma de atendimento psicológico online.    Seguro de Vida: Cobertura equivalente a 24 vezes o seu salário mensal.    Família, Parentalidade e Apoio     Licença Maternidade Estendida: 180 dias.     Licença Paternidade Estendida: 30 dias.  🧸 Auxílio Creche: Reembolso de R$ 676,81 – filhos até 2 anos; R$ 592,21 – filhos até 5 anos.  🧩 Auxílio PCD: Apoio de R$ 846,02 para filhos com deficiência ou neuro diversidade. title: Finance - Commercial Business Partner
description:
Empresa está contratando Finance - Commercial Business Partner em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Finance Manager - Commercial Business Partner  Energizer Holdings responsibly creates products to make lives easier and more enjoyable. To do this, we lean into our culture as an organization – we win together, while serving each other, with a willingness to act boldly, all while doing right. Our colleagues hail from all backgrounds, nationalities and walks of life, but our shared mission and purpose make us one team. Because we’re a global organization, you will always have opportunities to learn, grow and develop in your career. We support flexible working arrangements wherever possible.  The Commercial Business Partner Manager is responsible for creating and consolidating the annual budget, forecasting and reporting, and overseeing the business results for the Brazil market. It also involves delivering a comprehensive Profit and Loss (P&L) plan, forecasts, and variance analysis to the leadership team for Developing Markets.  The finance manager will share financial knowledge and reinforce key financial principles within the Commercial Organization. The candidate will lead the finance team by providing support and guidance, as well as offering financial assistance to the commercial director responsible for overseeing these markets.  The ideal candidate should be self-motivated, able to think strategically and proactively, and possess strong technical, managerial, and interpersonal skills to collaborate with partners at various levels.  Responsibilities   Plays an integral role in financial analysis, planning, reporting, consolidation and performance tracking of Brazil market.  Provide financial and business analysis to support commercial and Brand teams during business planning. Analyze Customer/Channel plans and trends to ensure financial expectations are achieved.  Partner with commercial teams to support and develop their business. Influence the Finance and Commercial Teams to help optimize Energizer’s sales and profit growth.  Develop and maintain financial tools and reporting systems to support commercial planning and forecasting efforts.Supervise the Trade Spend funds of its markets to optimize ROI and ensure financial objectives are met.  Ability to balance and leverage Strategic Objectives in addition to financial factors.  Partners with other members of the finance, supply chain, controllership, trade marketing, and marketing teams on cross-functional initiatives  Engage and develop every member of the finance team to continuously improve their performance.    What we are looking for   Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.  Minimum 5 years of experience in finance and accounting.  Minimum 3 years of financial business partnering/analytical experience.Broad P&L exposure.  Speaking Language: English fluent, Spanish is preferred.  Highly proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel and PowerPoint).  Proven ability to collaborate effectively with business partners.  Excellent communication skills (written and oral).  Strong analytical and problem resolution skills.  Must be a self-starter.  Capable of effectively working with remote teammates based in different countries.  Embodies Energizer’s leading other competencies: Strategic Thinking, Influence, Teamwork, passion, development of the organization, collaboration, Customer Focus, Achieving Results and Initiative.  Continuous improvement mindset with demonstrated ability to identify and implement process improvements to eliminate non-value-added work.  Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced and changing environment.  High activity environment requires the ability to handle multiple tasks to accomplish objectives.  Excellent time management skills and the ability to prioritize based on bi‑strategies and objectives.    Seniority level  Mid‑Senior level  Employment type  Full‑time  Job function   Finance  Manufacturing     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: SMB Customer Success Engineer

Monitor client performance metrics and proactively engage to reduce downtime and improve maintenance strategies. Deliver on-site training and guidance on predictive and preventive maintenance techniques. Collaborate with client teams on the factory floor to identify and address key operational pain points. Experience with tools like HubSpot and CRM systems is a plus.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

able to set KPIs and own outcomes Ability to translate technical concepts (stablecoins, on-chain payments, APIs, compliance) into clear value for executives and product leaders Full professional proficiency in Spanish; Portuguese strongly preferred Strong written skills for localization Practical fluency with CRM and marketing automation tools, analytics, and AI-driven content or translation workflows Based in LATAM (or ability to frequently travel to the region) Willing to travel: 25–40% for partners and events  What We Offer Competitive compensation Flexible remote work arrangement Travel to global team gatherings and industry events  We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. BENEFITS  Performance-based bonus. Extended Parental Leave (180 days for mothers and fathers). Birthday off. Parking. Medical and Dental Insurance. Group Life Insurance. Founded by serial entrepreneurs and supported by solid institutional investors, we are driven to disrupt this fast-growing industry.  Tenchi was created to tackle a real challenge: companies often face security risks because their third-parties don’t maintain the same level of cyber protection. This gap leaves even the largest organizations potentially vulnerable to incidents they can’t directly control. That’s exactly where we step in.  Our TPCRM SaaS solution, Zanshin, is the only global TPCRM solution that offers both inside-out and outside-in visibility - combining external attack surface monitoring with automated, continuous, and non-intrusive assessments of cloud infrastructure (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and security controls.  Our People and Culture  At Tenchi, we build innovative technology to help companies secure their ecosystems with transparency and peace of mind. We are ambitious and purpose-driven. Our culture is rooted in intentionality, transparency, and action. We move fast, communicate openly, and invest in people who want to make an impact.  As a 100% remote company with team members across Brazil, the US, Canada, Argentina, and Spain, we embrace flexibility while solving meaningful challenges together.    Want to know more about our DNA? Watch the video.   What will you do?    Help Tenchi clients understand our product features and best practices for reducing cyber risk in cloud environments, ensuring the successful adoption of our product integrated into the client's third-party risk management process.  Perform routine operations to meet our clients' requests, generating insights to guide future automation of these operations.  Diagnose product-related issues and work with the technical support and engineering teams to resolve client issues efficiently.  Monitor the health of client environments and collaborate with them to drive product adoption.  Work with the product team by providing customer feedback and offering insights for product improvements and enhancements.  Proactively engage with clients to identify their needs, concerns, and areas for improvement, assisting them in achieving their cybersecurity objectives. title: Regional Lobby Manager São Paulo
description:
Empresa está contratando Regional Lobby Manager São Paulo em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Reporting to the Head of Games Operations, the Regional Lobby Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management and optimisation of games lobbies across our LATAM markets, with a primary focus on Brazil and Mexico.  The Regional Lobby Manager will manage the sporty games lobby, ensuring optimal game positioning, effective promotions, strong supplier alignment, and high-quality internal reporting. The role plays a critical part in shaping the player experience and driving performance across the region.  What you'll be doing   Own and manage the sporty games lobby across all core LATAM markets (including BR and MX), ensuring optimal game positioning aligned with commercial strategy and player behaviour  Maximise visibility and discoverability of key games, promotions, and new releases within LATAM lobbies  Upload, schedule, and maintain promotional banners and in-lobby content, ensuring accuracy, relevance, and timely execution  Configure and maintain game settings, limits, and parameters in line with product, commercial, and regulatory requirements  Act as the regional point of contact for supplier needs related to lobby management, promotions, and releases  Partner closely with Product and Tech teams on testing, new feature rollouts, and improvements to categorisation and navigation  Optimise localisation across LATAM markets, ensuring content, naming, and presentation are culturally and linguistically appropriate  Use a data-driven approach to monitor lobby performance, player engagement, and promotional effectiveness, turning insights into actionable improvements  Produce and share clear internal feedback, performance updates, and reports to support decision-making across teams  Manage games-related escalations and operational queries, ensuring timely resolution and effective communication  Plan, coordinate, and map new game releases across LATAM markets, with a particular focus on sporty games  Align closely with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure all lobby content and configurations meet local regulatory requirements  Collaborate on release plans with internal studios and third-party suppliers to ensure smooth execution and strong regional impact    What you'll bring   Proven experience working with online casino games, ideally in lobby management, games operations, or content optimisation  Strong understanding of the LATAM market, particularly Brazil; local market knowledge is highly desirable  Analytical and data-driven mindset, with the ability to interpret performance data and make informed recommendations  Ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively with globally distributed teams  Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience working with suppliers and internal partners  Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, operational environment with competing priorities    What's in it for you   A competitive salary + individual performance based bonuses every quarter  28 days paid annual leave  Top of the line equipment  Annual company retreats to provide great internal networking opportunities    If you're interested, we encourage you to apply! Every application is reviewed by a member of our team (AI is not used in our recruitment process), and we aim to respond within 48 hours.  Sporty is committed to protecting your personal data and ensuring transparent, compliant handling of all information you provide during the application process. Your data will be processed in accordance with applicable privacy laws and retained securely. For details, please review our Privacy Policy.  We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Red Bull Student Marketeer  - Universidade São Judas Tadeu - Mooca
description:
Nova oportunidade para Red Bull Student Marketeer  - Universidade São Judas Tadeu - Mooca em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Overview Red Bull Student Marketeer - Universidade São Judas Tadeu - Mooca. Join to apply for the Red Bull Student Marketeer - Universidade São Judas Tadeu - Mooca role at Red Bull. Nossos Student Marketeers fazem parte do programa de embaixadores de marca mais dinâmico e capacitado do mundo. Eles entendem o público-alvo da Red Bull e são responsáveis por impulsionar a imagem da marca e a funcionalidade do produto em seu Campus e na região. O objetivo do programa Student Marketeer é alcançar novos consumidores, entusiasmar os estudantes universitários, aumentar as vendas e gerenciar a marca Red Bull em seu Campus. Isso inclui o contato direto com consumidores e clientes, convidando a experimentação de produtos, além de trabalhar em eventos da Red Bull para garantir uma experiência de marca inesquecível para os consumidores. Os Student Marketeers valorizam a flexibilidade em um trabalho e adoram trabalhar em um ambiente criativo. Responsabilidades principais:  SEJA UM EMBAIXADOR DA MARCA E PRODUTO. Viva e respire a personalidade da marca e os valores da empresa, representando a marca de forma excepcional através de interações diárias com os consumidores e/ou clientes. Aumente a base de consumidores convidando pessoas a experimentarem Red Bull, nos lugares certos e no momento certo, respondendo assertivamente a quaisquer perguntas dos consumidores. Crie e execute um plano personalizado e inovador no campus, envolvendo estudantes e dando vida à marca na universidade. Estabeleça uma sólida rede de contatos, através de relacionamentos com responsáveis-chave. Impulsione o envolvimento da marca em suas próprias redes sociais através de conteúdo autêntico. Trabalhe em eventos da Red Bull para garantir uma experiência de marca inesquecível para os consumidores. SEJA UM ESPECIALISTA EM VENDAS . Construa relacionamentos com clientes locais de pontos de venda e garanta que a Red Bull esteja disponível e visível aos consumidores. Colabore com as vendas para abrir novos pontos de distribuição para a Red Bull em seu campus e além. Aproveite os recursos relevantes do mundo Red Bull para manter a marca sempre presente nos clientes locais. Assegure a execução nos padrões de "loja perfeita". EXCELÊNCIA NA EXECUÇÃO . Demonstre excelência na execução e atenção aos detalhes em todas as áreas de atuação. Compartilhe ideias e colabore com a equipe por meio de interações regulares presenciais e online. Planeje e relate suas atividades através da plataforma online dedicada de forma pontual e precisa. Contribua para desenvolver as plataformas de mídia da Red Bull fornecendo informações locais, tendências e oportunidades gerais. Suas áreas de conhecimento e expertise mais relevantes para a vaga:  Apaixonado(a) pela marca e produto da Red Bull. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação. Personalidade carismática, enérgica, positiva e extrovertida. Imerso(a) na vida estudantil, com amplo entendimento do cenário universitário, cidade e região, incluindo atividades extracurriculares e pontos de interesse. Muito acessível e sociável, com capacidade de se relacionar com diferentes pessoas em diversas ocasiões. Possui uma mentalidade criativa e espírito empreendedor, com alto senso de responsabilidade e iniciativa. Capacidade de conciliar trabalho de meio período e estudos. Afinidade e desejo de aprender e aplicar uma nova gama de habilidades, especialmente em marketing e vendas. Conectado(a) com diversos grupos e indivíduos influentes no campus. Carteira de motorista válida.  Requisitos adicionais: estar matriculado e cursando a faculdade referente à vaga; formação a partir de Dez/27; CNH B. Acreditamos no potencial de todas as pessoas para contribuir com ideias independentemente de gênero, raça, religião, orientação afetivo-sexual, origem, idade e deficiência. No mundo da Red Bull todas as pessoas são bem-vindas. Observação: informações específicas sobre recrutamento podem variar; mantenha-se atento(a) às atualizações oficiais da vaga. title: [ 18/09/2025 ] Almoradí se suma al Día Mundial de la Limpieza Almoradí
description:
Empresa está contratando [ 18/09/2025 ] Almoradí se suma al Día Mundial de la Limpieza Almoradí em santos. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

El sábado 20 de septiembre  la Plaza de la Constitución  acogerá, de 10 a 13:30 horas, la XIII Jornada Medioambiental de Almoradí  El Ayuntamiento de Almoradí, a través de la Concejalía de Medio Ambiente que dirige Domingo Andreu  y con el respaldo de la alcaldesa María Gómez , organiza este fin de semana dos citas destacadas en torno a la sostenibilidad y el cuidado del entorno. El sábado 20 de septiembre  la Plaza de la Constitución  acogerá, de 10 a 13:30 horas, la XIII Jornada Medioambiental de Almoradí , un evento ya consolidado en el calendario local. La programación incluye talleres para todas las edades, como “Descubre el mundo de los bichos”, “Plantas aromáticas”, “Huertos urbanos” o “Recicla por el clima”. También habrá exposición de fósiles y minerales, intercambio de ropa sostenible y actividades de concienciación sobre reciclaje y uso responsable de recursos. La jornada contará además con la participación de la Concejalía de Protección Animal, cuyo responsable Víctor Argilés  ha anunciado la presencia de Esprineco , empresa contratada por el Ayuntamiento y centro en el que se encuentran los animales recogidos en la vía pública. Durante la feria se mostrarán algunos de ellos con el objetivo de darles visibilidad y facilitar su adopción. Por su parte, desde la Concejalía de Participación Ciudadana, también dirigida por Víctor Argilés , se instalará un stand donde se realizarán encuestas y se recogerán sugerencias y propuestas vecinales, fomentando así la implicación ciudadana en la mejora del municipio. El domingo 21 de septiembre , Almoradí se sumará al World Clean Up Day , Día Mundial de la Limpieza, en una acción simultánea que se llevará a cabo en varios municipios de la Vega Baja. La actividad está promovida por las asociaciones Vega Baja Limpia  y Mocho Costero , y en el caso de Almoradí tendrá como punto de encuentro el Auditorio Municipal (Calle Torrevieja, 3)  a las 10:00 horas . Desde allí los participantes recorrerán la Ruta del Agua  en una batida de limpieza ciudadana. El Ayuntamiento de Almoradí invita a toda la ciudadanía a participar en estas actividades que buscan sensibilizar sobre la importancia de la sostenibilidad, la protección animal, la reducción de residuos y la conservación del entorno natural. La construcción de este proyecto por parte de TM Grupo Inmobiliario supone una inversión de 140 millones de euros y la generación de miles de empleos directos e indirectos en la ciudad Compártelo: Haz clic (...)   #J-18808-Ljbffr

This is a chance to grow technically, influence product evolution, and thrive in an open, collaborative culture that values learning and excellence. Build the infrastructure and tooling required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) of data from various sources using Python, DBT, Terraform, and AWS technologies such as Glue, EMR, and S3.  Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements, including automating manual workflows, debugging and optimizing data delivery, and re-architecting infrastructure for enhanced scalability.  Apply the Data Quality Framework in the HRDM repository by developing unit tests, and creating both manual and automated test cases. title: Brazil Business Development Manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Brazil Business Development Manager em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Khan Academy is a fast‑paced nonprofit with a mission to provide a free, world‑class education to anyone, anywhere. Our proven learning platform offers high‑quality, supplemental content and practice—free of charge—covering core academic subjects from Pre‑K through 12th grade and early college, with a strong focus on math and science. We serve over 200 million registered learners across 190 countries and 55 languages, and we are committed to improving learning outcomes for students worldwide, especially those in historically under‑resourced communities. For more information, please see research findings about Khan Academy and our press center.  OUR COMMUNITY  Our students, teachers, and parents come from all walks of life, and so do we. Our team includes people from academia, education, big tech companies, and startups. We hire great people from diverse backgrounds and experiences because it makes our company stronger. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging as necessary to achieve our mission and impact the communities we serve. We know that transforming education starts in‑house with learning about ourselves and our colleagues. We strive to be world‑class in investing in our people and commit to developing you as a professional.  KHAN ACADEMY BRAZIL  Khan Academy Brazil delivers a world‑class experience, locally relevant with content, programs, and resources for students, teachers, schools, and districts. Our platform is a supplemental digital learning resource that provides interactive, mastery‑based activities for K–12 students in Math, Portuguese, and Science—all aligned with the BNCC. We serve over 11 million learners across our website, apps, and YouTube channels, and our goal is to scale impact through deeper partnerships with public districts and school systems.  ABOUT THE ROLE  Khan Academy Brazil is seeking a Business Development Manager focused on Government Growth to join a small, mission‑driven, highly collaborative team with a big goal: expanding Khan Academy’s reach in Brazilian public education through strategic partnerships and public procurement. This role blends public‑sector business development, partnership strategy, bidding processes, and project management. You will build and manage a pipeline of opportunities with public districts, lead end‑to‑end bid processes, and use our prior partnership experience with school systems as proof points to drive expansion to other districts. If you are comfortable moving between strategic conversations with public education leaders and deep dives into RFPs, bid documents, and implementation details, this role is for you.  Your key responsibilities  Strategic growth   Design and scale partnership models with public districts, aligning Khan Academy’s pedagogical, technological, and financial value proposition with district's priorities  Use our prior partnership experience with public school systems as reference cases, structuring learnings, evidence, and narratives that can be replicated with other districts  Support local leadership in growth strategy for public districts, including sales and marketing efforts, coordinating proposals, presentations, and relationship strategies  Support philanthropic and corporate partnership efforts when relevant, including contributing to proposals, reports, or relationship management    Public‑sector pipeline and bids   Build and manage a structured pipeline of public sector opportunities, mapping priority cities and states, upcoming tenders and public calls, and partnership opportunities  Act proactively in demand generation and pre‑tender influence, where appropriate and compliant, contributing with technical input and reference models  Lead or coordinate the full cycle of public bid responses, including:  Analyzing RFPs, bid documents, terms of reference, and draft contracts  Assessing risks and legal/compliance alignment in close collaboration with legal, finance, and other functional areas  Defining commercial models, scopes, timelines, and success criteria  Preparing and consolidating technical, pedagogical, financial, and institutional documentation  Track timelines, deliverables, clarifications, and potential appeals or challenges throughout the bidding process, in close collaboration with internal and external partners    Implementation and impact   Manage end-to‑end priority partnerships with public school systems, ensuring strong implementation that drives reach, engagement, and measurable learning outcomes for students and educators  Work closely with Khan's partnership functions to design implementation, training, and support plans tailored to each district and use quantitative and qualitative data to track key metrics and propose course corrections  Translate implementation learnings into playbooks for future partnerships with public systems, collaborating with local and international teams to iterate and scale best practices    Stakeholder and relationship building   Build and maintain trust‑based relationships with decision makers in public districts (pedagogical, technical, procurement teams, among others), navigating complex political and institutional environments with empathy, strategic insight, and integrity, in order to drive change management and system‑level adoption of Khan Academy  When relevant, support philanthropic and corporate partnership efforts (funders, foundations, corporate CSR) especially when connected to programs with public districts  Act as a champion for public‑sector partners, educators, and students inside Khan Academy, bringing structured feedback to content, product, support, and strategy teams    ABOUT YOU  What you bring   10+ years of relevant experience in education, business development, consulting, sales to government, public‑sector programs, or large‑scale partnerships, with proven experience selling to or managing contracts with the public sector, ideally in education or govtech, including exposure to public procurement processes and interaction with oversight bodies  At least 3 years managing institutional partner relationships (e.g., customer success, account management, public‑sector program management) and leading complex projects or multi‑stakeholder implementations with clear, measurable outcomes  Strong business development and account management acumen, including the ability to identify new opportunities, build trust with institutional partners, and support proposal and sales cycles in the public sector  Excellent project and program management skills, with a track record of executing high‑impact initiatives across multiple districts or partners simultaneously  Advanced collaboration and influence skills, able to align internal and external stakeholders, manage cross‑functional dependencies, and drive progress without formal authority  Strong strategic and adaptive problem‑solving, able to navigate ambiguity, co‑create solutions with district leaders, and iterate based on evolving needs and political contexts  Excellent communication skills across formats and audiences, including emails, briefs, presentations, and verbal interactions with senior education leaders and technical teams  Comfort and fluency working with qualitative and quantitative data, including analyzing trends, interpreting dashboards, and extracting insights to inform decisions  Outstanding organization and time‑management abilities, capable of coordinating multiple workstreams with high attention to detail  Professionalism, discretion, and integrity, especially when managing sensitive partnerships or navigating politically complex environments  Residency in, or willingness to relocate to, São Paulo, with legal authorization to work in Brazil  Fluency in Portuguese and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages    You would be a great fit if you have   Experience working with public education systems, NGOs, or government organizations, with a strong understanding of the realities and needs of teachers, school leaders, and district administrators  Demonstrated passion for education equity and innovation, with a commitment to supporting public schools and underserved communities  Proficiency with productivity and collaboration tools, such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and project management platforms (e.g., Jira, Trello, Asana, or similar)  Familiarity with AI‑powered tools for content creation, data analysis, or workflow efficiency, with curiosity about leveraging technology to improve educational outcomes  Coaching and facilitation skills, with the ability to support capacity‑building in school systems through empathetic guidance, strategic questioning, and constructive feedback  Experience with or exposure to philanthropic partnerships or CSR initiatives, especially those connected to public education    What is nice to have   Classroom teaching experience, preferably in K–12 settings, which provides valuable perspective when engaging with educators and supporting implementation  First‑hand experience using Khan Academy with students, with insight into how the platform supports instruction differentiation and learning personalization    PERKS AND BENEFITS  We may be a nonprofit, but we take great care of our team. You can expect:   Competitive compensation with healthcare and life insurance benefits  Flexible schedules and generous time off, including personal days beyond standard vacation  A strong focus on professional development and continuous learning  An exceptional team that trusts you, supports you, and gives you autonomy to do your best work  The opportunity to apply your talents to a meaningful mission, contributing to high‑impact offerings that are shaping the future of education  A kind, inclusive, and welcoming workplace, with affinity groups, ally networks, and social activities to help you connect and belong    Live & breathe learners  We deeply understand and empathize with our users. We leverage user insights, research, and experience to build content, products, services, and experiences that our users trust and love. Our success is defined by the success of our learners and educators.  Take a stand  As a company, we have conviction in our aspirational point of view of how education will evolve. The work we do is in service to moving towards that point of view. However, we also listen, learn and flex in the face of new data, and commit to evolving this point of view as the industry and our users evolve.  Embrace diverse perspectives  We are a diverse community. We seek out and embrace a diversity of voices, perspectives and life experiences leading to stronger, more inclusive teams and better outcomes. As individuals, we are committed to bringing up tough topics and leaning into different points of view with curiosity. We actively listen, learn and collaborate to gain a shared understanding. When a decision is made, we commit to moving forward as a united team.  Work responsibly and sustainably  We understand that achieving our audacious mission is a marathon, so we set realistic timelines and we focus on delivery that also links to the bigger picture. As a non‑profit, we are supported by the generosity of donors as well as strategic partners, and understand our responsibility to our finite resources. We spend every dollar as though it were our own. We are responsible for the impact we have on the world and to each other. We ensure our team and company stay healthy and financially sustainable.  Bring out the joy  We are committed to making learning a joyful process. This informs what we build for our users and the culture we co‑create with our teammates, partners and donors.  Cultivate learning mindset  We believe in the power of growth for learners and for ourselves. We constantly learn and teach to improve our offerings, ourselves, and our organization. We learn from our mistakes and aren’t afraid to fail. We don't let past failures or successes stop us from taking future bold action and achieving our goals.  Deliver wow  We insist on high standards and deliver delightful, effective end‑to‑end experiences that our users can rely on. We choose to focus on fewer things — each of which aligns to our ambitious vision — so we can deliver high-quality experiences that accelerate positive measurable learning with our strategic partners.  HOW TO APPLY   Attach your resume or Linkedin URL in the space provided below.  Please address the below‑mentioned task and attach your response in the space provided below.    TASK  Describe a public‑sector partnership or bid process where you played a leading role. In your answer, briefly cover:   The context and goal of the opportunity  The key actions you led (e.g., stakeholder engagement, proposal/bid work, internal alignment)  The outcome and one key learning    Please anonymize any confidential information and limit your response to one page.  We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we encourage candidates from historically underrepresented groups to apply.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Consultor Comercial (CLOSER) - PJ
description:

Você ama vender? Em especial quando é uma solução que você sabe que vai transformar a vida do cliente?Você ama aquele frio na barriga quando o cliente vai dar o aceite ou não da proposta?Ama quebrar as objeções e fazer o cliente perceber que sua solução é a melhor opção?Então talvez esta vaga seja para você!Na 4blue, nosso propósito é claro:  transformar a vida de empresários e construir um mundo onde empreender vale a pena. Desde 2009, nos consagramos como referência em Gestão Empresarial para pequenas e médias empresas , ajudando empresários a tirar seus sonhos do papel e alcançar resultados reais .Para esta grande missão, estamos sempre em busca de pessoas com muita energia, que têm a vontade de ir além e que sonham grande para somar com a gente em nossa missão.Por que você vai se apaixonar pela 4blue?  Se vocêsonha grande ,tem energia para transformar vidas equer fazer parte de algo realmente relevante , você vai se sentir em casa aqui.  Nosso trabalho vai muito além de "ensinar":nós inspiramos e guiamos empreendedores rumo ao sucesso , ajudando-os a superar desafios sem precisar passar pelo medo de falir ou pelo estresse de não crescer. Aquijogamos para ganhar . Oferecemos cursos e consultorias, avaliamos e damos feedback. Sempre querendo melhorar, sempre jogando para ganhar. Se a empresa ganha, você ganha. Nossaparticipação nos lucros pode te fazer tirar 1, 2, até 3 salários extras no ano! Leveza com responsa . Somos leves e damos risada mesmo quando as coisas estão difíceis. Não gritamos, não brigamos, não humilhamos. Nossagestão é humana e verdadeiramente nos importamos com as pessoas. Sim, somos leves,mas jogamos pra ganhar e vamos ganhar . Home office: mais tempo no seu dia. O que dá pra fazer com 1 a 2 horas a mais no dia? Tem gente que acredita que trabalhar de casa não funciona, aqui provamos que dá sim pra trabalhar de casa com foco e com resultado, mas com muito mais qualidade de vida.  Sobre a vaga: O Consultor Comercial (Closer) é responsável por conduzir reuniões e negociações comerciais, gerenciar o relacionamento com clientes, pelo fechamento de contratos, bem como ajudar a melhorar o processo de vendas para aumentas as taxas de conversão. Sua missão é VENDER! Principais Missões: Realizar reuniões de vendas: Realizar reuniões com os clientes (em média de 4 a 5 por dia) para identificar a necessidade do cliente, apresentar nossa melhor solução e fazer o cliente sentir um desejo incontrolável pela nossa solução; Gestão de relacionamento com clientes: Manter um relacionamento próximo com os clientes, tirando dúvidas, quebrando objeções, buscando o "sim" ou "não" de nossa proposta; Atualização e Gestão do CRM: Registrar as interações e status dos leads, mantendo um controle preciso do funil de vendas; Participação em Treinamentos e Desenvolvimento: Estar em constante desenvolvimento, participando de treinamentos e melhorando as habilidades que aumentem suas taxas de conversão; Apoio ao Time e Melhoria de Processos: Ajudar o time com insights sobre leads, auxiliar na preparação de estratégias de vendas, dar sugestões para melhoria do processo comercial; Disponibilidade para viagens eventuais para participação em eventos presenciais.   RemuneraçãoO Closer receberá uma remuneração fixa compatível com o mercado + variável por performance.As comissões, na média, vão de 3 mil reais a 7 mil reais por mês, porém não há um teto na remuneração, logo estes valores podem se tornar muito superior a depender da performance.O que buscamos de um futuro Blue: Requisitos Essenciais  Habilidade em vendas, boa comunicação verbal e escrita Experiência sólida em vendas consultivas Postura profissional, autoridade e segurança no trabalho Inteligência emocional - saber lidar sob pressão, saber lidar com objeções, saber lidar com o "não" do cliente Espaço silencioso em sua casa para trabalhar  Requisitos desejáveis (serão um baita diferencial):   Conhecimento e experiência em gestão de negócios.  Domínio de Técnicas de Fechamento/Negociação Avançadas (PNL, Spin Selling, etc) Experiência com home office.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Narrative Designer | Talent Pool
description:
Nova oportunidade para Narrative Designer | Talent Pool em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

We are ARVORE, a startup in the virtual reality content creation scene. Based in São Paulo, our studio creates, designs, produces, and develops world-class interactive experiences and games for all current and future high-end immersive platforms, including virtual reality, augmented reality, and mixed reality. ARVORE is looking to hire a technically adept, creative individual to complement our team. You will have the opportunity to work on innovative immersive and narrative-driven XR experiences, iterating and prototyping with a high level of creative freedom and with the opportunity to guide the direction of some of these endeavors. Our process emphasizes teamwork, agility, and multidisciplinarity. We are seeking a passionate and self-motivated person with a positive attitude and a genuine team spirit, who enjoys sharing knowledge and is open to learning from others. We embrace problem solvers, those unafraid to experiment and fail, and who are ready to create something new. JOB DESCRIPTION ARVORE seeks a creative NARRATIVE DESIGNER  to design the narrative elements of our experiences and to champion story within the development process. When designing a narrative, we all know the golden rule: “show, don’t tell”. In interactive content, we may also add “do, don’t show”. The Narrative Designer must think in actions and interactions, inviting the audience to take actions and immerse their bodies within a story. It is crucial to consider the medium and the user’s body when designing a VR experience. The ND's role is to ensure that interactions and narrative work seamlessly, considering the specificities of each project. MAIN CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ACTIVITIES: Conceive, create, and advocate for appropriate narrative features within the team, writing narrative content and ensuring it is embraced by the final product; Develop documents and tools that materialize the project's narrative content, such as emotion curves, beat sheets, synopses, mind maps, screenplays, and similar tools; Create descriptions and backstories for characters, locations, objects, and events, collaborating with the Production Design team and the creative director to develop worldbuilding systems; Collaborate with the Development team to create real-time tools for implementing the narrative content in the experience; Work with the Game Design team and Creative Director to define the flow of events, overseeing dialogues, animations, audio, event timings, props, etc.; Create functional documentation to keep the team and stakeholders informed about the narrative elements; Ensure the project is understandable and cohesive from the user’s perspective, following and reporting on user tests; Produce summaries of the narrative content for distribution, such as festival registrations and pitch decks; Build a repertoire of narrative VR experiences and present new immersive experiences to the team.  MUST HAVE: Exceptional writing ability; Fluency in Portuguese and English; Willingness to observe, absorb, and modify their work per project needs; Strong interpersonal skills for effective communication across disciplines; Previous experience in narrative content creation teams; Constantly seeking to learn new skills and expand their repertoire; Ability to give and receive constructive and creative feedback; Deep understanding of narrative structures, plot beats, emotional progression, and classical storytelling elements; Ability to balance narrative, interaction, and ludology aspects in immersive experiences, integrating story and gameplay; Passion for movies, TV, visual arts, literature, theater, and great stories across media; Experience in scriptwriting for film, TV, or games; Technical or Bachelor of Arts degree in Cinema, Media, Creative Writing, Literature, or equivalent practical experience; Openness to learning new methods and frameworks.  NICE TO HAVE: Familiarity with Google G Suite and screenwriting software; Previous experience with VR and AR content; Experience working in a studio or production company; Video game industry experience; A passion for Virtual Reality.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

A nossa experiência em cuidados renais remonta há mais de 25 anos e temos estado na vanguarda do setor desde então. As nossas operações abrangem atualmente 24 países, com mais de 14.000 funcionários motivados que atendem uma base de pacientes de mais de 40.000 indivíduos. Atividades:  Fornece terapia de diálise crônica, incluindo, mas não se limitando à formulação de um plano de diálise com ultra filtração, iniciando a diálise através de vários acessos, cumprindo as medidas de segurança e monitorando os sinais vitais do paciente aplicáveis aos pacientes com insuficiência renal crônica de acordo com o Plano de Cuidados. Prepara e administra medicamentos, fluido terapia ou outros tratamentos apropriados por prescrição médica e realiza as respectivas documentações no prontuário do paciente. Analisa dados do paciente; avalia e monitoriza o status dos acessos vasculares, revisa resultados laboratoriais, avaliações de pacientes e relata quaisquer alterações ou anormalidades relevantes ao médico plantonista. Monitoriza o sistema de tratamento de água de diálise para uso de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos. Montar e verificar o funcionamento dos aparelhos de hemodiálise, garantindo que todos os dispositivos estejam limpos, funcionais e calibrados. Avaliar as condições clínicas do paciente antes e após a sessão, incluindo sinais vitais e acesso vascular. Observar continuamente os sinais vitais e os parâmetros do aparelho durante a hemodiálise para garantir a eficácia e a segurança do tratamento, ajustar o fluxo sanguíneo e os parâmetros da máquina conforme necessário. Realizar uma avaliação inicial detalhada, coletando informações sobre sintomas, histórico médico e alterações recentes no estado de saúde. Inspecionar e cuidar do acesso vascular para prevenir infecções e complicações, instruir o paciente sobre cuidados domiciliares com o acesso. Manter registros detalhados sobre o tratamento, incluindo dados vitais, parâmetros da máquina, e qualquer evento adverso. Assegurar que a documentação seja completa e precisa. Relatar alterações no estado do paciente e resultados das sessões à equipe médica e outros profissionais de saúde envolvidos no cuidado. Assegurar que todos os procedimentos sejam realizados de acordo com as normas e protocolos estabelecidos pela Diaverum Brasil. Fornece educação continuada ao paciente e respectivo prestador de cuidados. Participa proativamente em programas de melhoria de qualidade.  Requisitos:  Graduação em Enfermagem; Registro no COREN; Experiência em procedimentos hospitalares e Hemodiálise; Especialização em Nefrologia (desejável). title: Assessora ou Assessor Tributário Senior - Preços de Transferência
description:
Empresa está contratando Assessora ou Assessor Tributário Senior - Preços de Transferência em limeira. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Assessora ou Assessor Tributário Senior - Preços de Transferência Localização primária: Rio de Janeiro Outras localidades: Em qualquer lugar da Região Remuneração: Pacote a ser detalhado Data da abertura da vaga: 24 de nov. de 2025 Descrição da oportunidade ID da requisição:   Oportunidade disponível para contratação híbrida nos escritórios de São Paulo, Campinas, Rio de Janeiro e Curitiba. Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você. Em Impostos, estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros.#TaxEY  Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?  Como uma pessoaAssessora Tributária Sênior de Preços de Transferência (OCDE) você será parte da área de TAX atuando na definição de preços dos produtos produzidos no exterior e vendidos no Brasil. Prestando assessoria tributária para atendimento as regras de preços de transferência realizando revisão, documentação, gerenciamento e defesa das políticas de preços de transferência, além da preparação de cálculos e documentos pertinentes para o cumprimento de obrigações principais e acessórias, assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades: Realizar análises de preços de transferência sob a ótica das diretrizes da OCDE; Coordenar projetos globais ou regionais de documentação de preços de transferência envolvendo diversas jurisdições - CbCR, Master File, Local File e Benchmarkanálises); Auxiliar no desenvolvimento, implementação e monitoramento de políticas de preços de transferência para empresas multinacionais brasileiras e internacionais; Participar de projetos de auditoria para realizar revisões sob a ótica de preços de transferência; Desenvolver a equipenas melhores práticas de preços de transferência; Entender as linhas de serviço da EY e incentivar, de forma ativa, as pessoas da equipe a contribuírem com ideias e identificaroportunidades de aplicação dos serviços que podemos oferecer aos nossos clientes; Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos e exposições.  Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua: Experiência na área de preços de transferência (in houseouBig4); Inglês avançado ou fluente; Graduação em economia, contabilidade ou administração; Habilidade na comunicação verbal; Habilidade no trabalho em equipe eliderança.  Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos: Conhecimento em espanhol; Habilidades analíticas financeiras e contábeis e domínio do pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); Vivência em projetos de suporte a auditoria, compliance e planejamento tributário; Conhecimento em Digital TAX.  O que oferecemos: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Cliqueaqui e conheça nosso universo debenefícios . Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão. Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias. Segundo o Great Place to Work 2022, somos a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+ do Brasil, e a 2a melhor empresa para Mulheres e para Pessoas Pretas.Assim, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade. Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado?Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor!  Saiba mais sobre como é trabalhar na EY: Selecione a frequência (em dias) de recebimento de alertas: EY refere-se à organização global e pode se referir a uma ou mais das firmas-membro da Ernst & Young Global Limited, cada uma das quais é uma entidade jurídica separada. A Ernst & Young Global Limited, empresa britânica limitada por garantia, não presta serviços aos clientes.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Precisamos de pessoas comprometidas, curiosas, empreendedoras, comunicativas e com bastante vontade de aprender com a gente. Para essa vaga a alocação será em nossa fábrica de software, para um projeto em colaboração com um dos maiores bancos digitais do mercado brasileiro, e vai fazer uma imersão no mundo de tecnologia e finanças. Terá a oportunidade de participar com a equipe em todas as fases do projeto, garantindo entregas de qualidade do produto e trabalhando em conjunto com outros profissionais de tecnologia qualificados. E isso é só o começo! Nossa meta é crescer 10X nos próximos dois anos, vem com a gente? Participar da definição e revisão da arquitetura dos sitemas Trabalhar em conjunto com outros desenvolvedores de nível júnior até especialista Escrita de código em Java na maior parte do tempo de desenvolvimento Escrever testes unitários e de integração Ensinar e aprender sobre tecnologia e o mundo fintech Auxiliar na melhoria da infraestrutura para certificar que as boas práticas estejam sendo cumpridas e focar em estabilidade, escalabilidade e manutenção do produto Participar de reuniões técnicas com equipes externas Ser parte de um time qualificado que está criando novas oportunidades para o setor financeiro das empresas brasileiras. A linguagem de programação que mais irá usar é Java (Spring Framework), para backend, e TypeScript + ReactJS para frontend, então esses conhecimentos são diferenciais. Precisa ter vontade e interesse de aprender fluxos e processos financeiros, absorvendo os conceitos de mercado para auxiliar na evolução tecnológica dos produtos. Especialistas em tecnologia e infraestrutura de crédito Ajudamos startups, fintechs e empresas em geral a criar suas próprias operações de crédito, utilizando nossa plataforma tecnológica e licenças financeiras. Somos curiosos, inquietos e sempre abertos para mudanças. Buscamos entregar sempre as melhores soluções tecnológicas, com extrema qualidade e segurança. Seguimos as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento de software e metodologias ágeis para gestão do nosso time. Nascemos como uma empresa de tecnologia e entregamos nossas soluções de forma transparente, sempre via APIs, plataformas white-label e integrações, para que nossos clientes consigam criar a melhor experiência possível para seus usuários utilizarem suas soluções financeiras.  #J-18808-Ljbffr

About us  Insider One is the #1 platform  that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.   Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry‑first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices . With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels , including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.  We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic . We are backed by top‑notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst , and trusted by 2000+ customers from high‑growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino’s, and the list goes on.  Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman‑foundated, women‑led B2B SaaS unicorns  in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader  in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it – see for yourself. The results speak for themselves.   From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world‑class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities  in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables , our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.  Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers  that moves fast and agile, creating cutting‑edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.  As a Customer Onboarding Manager, you will be responsible for driving the onboarding process, ensuring successful and timely outcomes for new clients. Your role is crucial in accelerating time to value and ensuring customer retention by helping clients fully integrate and realize the value of Insider One’s platform.  You will collaborate closely with internal technical resources to empower and train customers on how to use Insider One’s platform and its powerful features as efficiently as possible. Establishing strong, credible relationships with stakeholders at all levels of the client organization will be key to understanding their business and technical goals.  Role Expectations  You will be expected to have a technical background, which could be gained through either academic education or relevant work experience. This includes the ability to read API documentation, knowledge of HTML, CSS, and XML, and the ability to understand basic data structures and data flows.  You will be prioritized if you have experience with short‑to‑medium‑term projects and strong project management skills, as your role will heavily focus on managing multiple projects simultaneously.  What You Will Do   Project management of customer onboardings to ensure successful outcomes, accelerating time to value and driving customer growth and retention.  Collaborate with internal technical teams to train customers on using Insider One’s platform and features effectively.  Build credible relationships with stakeholders at all levels, from senior management to end users, to understand their business and technical goals.  Drive early adoption by setting KPIs and success metrics, ensuring full ROI for clients.  Advocate for customer business use cases with the product development team.  Ensure smooth transition to the Customer Success Manager team by documenting client stakeholder roles and hierarchy.  Continuously enhance the onboarding experience by improving processes and training materials.  Where needed, tailor 1:1 onsite and remote onboarding sessions to exceed client expectations.  Establish trust and confidence in Insider One’s platform, ensuring successful early adoption.  Coordinate effectively with client agencies and third parties to achieve desired outcomes.  Ensure the highest quality in deliverables, maintaining client satisfaction and facilitating a seamless post‑onboarding transition to the Customer Success & Support teams.  Collaborate with the development team to ensure custom development meets client expectations and standards.  Own the project, taking responsibility for successful implementation while working closely with both internal and external stakeholders.  Facilitate exceptional user‑enablement training and workshops to empower clients.    What You Will Need   Minimum of 3 years of experience in SaaS project management and client onboarding.  PM qualifications such as Agile, PMP, or Prince2 are a plus.  Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with business fluency in English.  Time and task management skills are essential.  Proven ability to communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.  Demonstrated success in delivering projects in a timely and efficient manner.  Knowledge of Google Tag Manager, Google Product Feed, and Google Analytics is an advantage.  Understanding of webhooks and APIs.  Exposure to and understanding of AI‑driven product recommendation tools and algorithms is a plus.  Experience with other CRM, ERP, or marketing automation platforms is an advantage.    What We Offer   Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets — where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together.  Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills.  Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and CloudGuru.  Become a Shareowner through our eligibility‑based “ESOP” and own a piece of what you build.  Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses.  Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose‑driven social impact projects.  From global retreats to team‑building activities, expect year‑round events that turn into lifelong memories.    We aren’t just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there.  To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good‑hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.  If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.  We provide equal opportunity in a zero‑discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.  Follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and Medium!    #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Growth Marketing Analyst (PLG)
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior Growth Marketing Analyst (PLG) em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

We are a global technology company specializing in digital applications and security. Our platform helps companies operate more agilely, reducing response times and increasing the reliability of their systems.  At Azion, our purpose is to simplify application development and transform the future with cutting-edge technology. Here, you will have the chance to develop in an innovative environment, alongside a high-performance team, working on real challenges and creating solutions that make a difference.  About the position  We are looking for a Senior  Growth Marketing Analyst  to join our Marketing & Growth team in our São Paulo office. As part of the Marketing & Growth team, the successful candidate will be responsible for designing, executing, and optimizing product-led growth strategies across our self-serve funnel—from acquisition and activation to monetization and retention.  You will own the experimentation roadmap, build lifecycle and in-product experiences that drive the “aha” moment and habit formation, define and operationalize PQLs, and partner closely with Product Engineering, Data, and Sales to accelerate revenue from our self-serve and product-qualified motions.  Your Impact   Own self-serve funnel KPIs (signup → activation → PQL → paid → retention) and deliver quarter-over-quarter improvements aligned to our plans and a clear North Star metric;  Build and run a rigorous experimentation program across website, onboarding, in-app paywalls, and pricing/packaging; translate results into shipped improvements;  Design and launch lifecycle programs (email, in-app, push) that guide users to activation, expand adoption, and reduce churn, leveraging segmentation and personalization;  Define PQL scoring and routing; implement lead capture, intent signals, and sales handoff processes with RevOps to enable product-led sales;  Partner with Product Engineering and Data to instrument analytics, create dashboards, and socialize insights that inform roadmap, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.    What You’ll Bring   Solid experience in B2B SaaS growth/marketing with 2–3+ years driving PLG at scale; proven impact on activation, conversion, and net revenue retention;  Strong analytical toolkit: proficiency in SQL and experimentation analysis; comfort with cohort/retention modeling, LTV/CAC, payback, and pricing/packaging tradeoffs;  Hands‑on with PLG tooling: product analytics (Amplitude/Mixpanel), CDP (Segment), marketing automation (HubSpot/Braze/Customer.io), A/B testing (Optimizely/LaunchDarkly), and web analytics (GA4/Tag Manager);  Excellent product sense and messaging skills; can craft crisp in-product copy and lifecycle communications grounded in user research and JTBD frameworks;  High‑ownership, cross‑functional collaborator who can prioritize ruthlessly, manage a backlog, and influence without authority in a fast‑paced environment.    Bonus Points   Experience with freemium or usage-based models, paywall design, and pricing experimentation;  Familiarity with modeling PQLs using scoring/ML and building referral or viral loops that compound growth.    Benefits & Azion Way of Life   CLT hiring model;  Health and dental plan;  Flexible VR and VA (Flash Card), including during vacation periods;  Transport voucher without payroll deduction;  Mobility allowance (additional amount for travel);  Freestyle (incentive to customize the workstation);  Stock options (according to policy);  Birthday day off;  TotalPass;  Flexible working hours (really flexible);  Nomad Program to work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year (according to policy);  Annual international exchange program.    FlexWork Model  We offer a FlexWork model that prioritizes acculturation and collaboration. For the first three months, you will work on‑site  in the local office, an essential step in building solid relationships and a genuine connection with our values and culture. We believe that this initial immersion not only strengthens the team, but also boosts creativity and innovation.  After this period, you will have the possibility to apply for the hybrid  model, working on‑site at least three times a week. This approach balances interaction in person and autonomy, creating a dynamic and productive working environment.  At Azion, all applications are welcome, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, pregnancy, disability, ethnicity, color, country of origin, or religion. We believe that an inclusive environment contributes to our success and that respect is present in all our relationships.  Come and join our team! We look forward to getting to know you and walking a path of success in technology together!   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Descrição da vaga  Junta-se a nós e venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializada em assistência à aviação no Brasil. ✈️   Adnata Brasil  opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados;somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções .  Globalmente, Adnata  foi fundada em 1959, em Dubai. Possuímos mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países, nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes pelo mundo.  Estas são oportunidades exclusivas para PcDs na nossa base em CWB .  Responsabilidades e atribuições  Possuímos várias posições disponíveis com foco operacional, as principais sendo:   Auxiliar de Rampa     As atividades consistem na movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos. Dentre os equipamentos e mobiliários utilizados destacam-se telefone e rádio de comunicação. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.  Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco, esforço físico e deambulação por toda área operacional.  Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos, percepção auditiva para identificação de sinais sonoros de equipamentos e máquinas na pista.  Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.   Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais (Limpeza)     As atividades consistem na organização da bolsa de suprimentos, aguardo da liberação de limpeza pela tripulação, acoplamento da escada na aeronave, coleta dos sacos de lixos, reposição dos suprimentos, aspiração do carpete, verificação da presença de objetos e higienização das poltronas e de bolsões, preenchimento de documentação do voo e limpeza das salas administrativas. Dentre os equipamentos utilizados destacam-se telefone, aspirador, panos, sacos de lixo, lixeira e bolsa de suprimentos. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.  Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, deambulação por toda extensão do aeroporto para o atendimento do voo, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico para limpeza e deslocamento da escada da aeronave.  Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para inspeções e limpezas e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais em áreas operacionais.  Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.   Auxiliar Administrativo (Operações)     As atividades consistem na gestão do faturamento e conciliação documental diária dos voos realizados, encaminhamento para departamento financeiro, elaboração de relatórios, lançamento de dados no sistema, arquivo, leitura e envio de e-mail. Dentre os equipamentos e mobiliários utilizados destacam-se cadeira, mesa, arquivos, microcomputador, impressora com 1,28m de altura do piso e telefone. O setor encontra-se no piso térreo, com deslocamento do colaborador pelas áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto por meio de elevadores e escadas rolantes.  Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, eventualmente existe a necessidade de esforço físico e deambulação entre áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto.  Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para elaboração de relatórios, leitura e elaboração de e-mails, faturamento, lançamento de dados no sistema, e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e aos colaboradores, visitantes e clientes.  Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.  Requisitos e qualificações   Ensino médio concluído;  Boa comunicação interpessoal;  Proatividade;  Vontade de aprender;  Vontade de trabalhar em equipe;  Disciplina e organização;  Disponibilidade de horário e para trabalhar em turnos rotativos presenciais;    Informações adicionais  Todos os envios de CV devem vir obrigatoriamente acompanhados do "LAUDO CARACTERIZADOR DE DEFICIÊNCIA ". De acordo com o Decreto 3.298/1999 e com a Instrução Normativa SIT/ MTE n.º 98 de 15/08/2012, observados os dispositivos da Convenção sobre os Direitos das Pessoas com deficiência, Lei 12764/12, Lei 13146/2015.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:

Reports To:  IT Manager  Department  :  Information technologyLocation  : Blumenau, Brazil - Hybrid  At MTech Systems, our company mission is to increase yield in protein production to help feed the growing world population without compromising animal welfare or damaging the planet. We aim to create software that delivers real-time data to the entire supply chain that allows producers to get better insight into what is happening on their farms and what they can do to responsibly improve production.  MTech Systems is a prominent provider of tools for managing performance in Live Animal Protein Production. For over 30 years, MTech Systems has provided cutting‑edge enterprise data solutions for all aspects of the live poultry operations cycle. We provide our customers with solutions in Business Intelligence, Live Production Accounting, Production Planning, and Remote Data Management—all through an integrated system. Our applications can currently be found running businesses on six continents in over 50 countries. MTech has built an international reputation for equipping our customers with the power to utilize comprehensive data to maximize profitability.  With over 250 employees globally, MTech Systems currently has main offices in Mexico, United States, and Brazil, with additional resources in key markets around the world. MTech Systems USA’s headquarters is based in Atlanta, Georgia and has approximately 90 team members in a casual, collaborative environment. Our work culture here is based on a commitment to helping our clients feed the world, resulting in a flexible and rewarding atmosphere. We are committed to maintaining a work culture that enhances collaboration, provides robust development tools, offers training programs, and allows for direct access to senior and executive management.  Job Summary  We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with strong customer‑facing experience to join our IT team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of cloud architecture, automation, and customer success. You’ll work closely with internal teams and external customers to design, deploy, and support scalable, secure, and cost‑effective cloud infrastructure—primarily in Microsoft Azure.  You’ll play a key role in modernizing our infrastructure, supporting SaaS deployments, and ensuring our customers have a seamless experience with our cloud‑hosted solutions. This is a hands‑on engineering role with a strong emphasis on communication, collaboration, and continuous improvement.  Responsibilities  Key Responsibilities   Design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure to support customer‑facing applications.  Collaborate with product, development, and customer success teams to ensure infrastructure meets customer needs and SLAs.  Lead cloud onboarding and deployment efforts for new customers, including infrastructure provisioning, networking, and security configuration.  Optimize cloud costs and performance through proactive analysis and automation.  Serve as a technical advisor to customers and internal stakeholders on cloud best practices, security, and architecture.  Document infrastructure designs, runbooks, and customer‑specific configurations.  Provide Tier 3 support for cloud‑related issues and participate in incident response and root cause analysis.  Stay current with emerging cloud technologies and recommend improvements to our cloud strategy.    Minimum Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.  5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering or systems administration, with at least 2 years in a customer‑facing or consulting role.  Proficient in Microsoft Azure, including Azure AD, networking, storage, and compute services.  Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, or Python.  Excellent communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders.    Preferred Qualifications   Experience with hybrid cloud environments and legacy system integration.  Familiarity with customer onboarding, technical account management, or solution architecture.  Knowledge of security frameworks and compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001).    EEO Statement  Integrated into our shared values is MTech’s commitment to diversity and equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. MTech aims to maintain a global inclusive workplace where every person is regarded fairly, appreciated for their uniqueness, advanced according to their accomplishments, and encouraged to fulfill their highest potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at MTech has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment. title: Mecânico de Manutenção
description:
